title: TECMP: Adding Subdissector support
description:
Adding subdissector support based on interface_id. This allows to write
custom dissectors for e.g. UART/RS232 data.

TECMP: Adding Subdissector support

Adding subdissector support based on interface_id. This allows to write
custom dissectors for e.g. UART/RS232 data.
